races.paceDynamic: Three Socks On will take the lead from the outset with no other confirmed front runners in this field. The prominent runner will set a controlled, sustainable tempo on the soft ground over this extended distance. Behind, seven hold-up horses including Lavender Gold, Semper Femina, and Exquisite Skye will be patient in the pack, relying on late kicks. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and patient hold-up horses who can quicken late, while mid-division horses may get caught in no-man's land.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Three Socks On gets an easy lead and controls fractions
scenarios.body: The prominent runner dictates terms without pressure and has enough left to resist late challengers on testing ground. Hold-up horses struggle to close the gap with the steady tempo never setting up a strong finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Kick Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too steady and hold-up horses get perfect splits
scenarios.body: Patient runners with the strongest finishing kicks exploit the moderate gallop to unleash devastating late runs. The leader weakens after doing too much work alone in testing conditions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Improved Handicapper Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Three Socks On sets strong pace but tires in final furlong
scenarios.body: The honest leader's effort sets up the race for a lightly-weighted improver to strike late. Marveling or Hove Ranger capitalize on their low marks and recent form improvement.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Problems Cause Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the field bunches up and several hold-up horses get blocked
scenarios.body: Poor draws or positioning leave several fancied runners with too much to do when the gaps finally appear. An unconsidered runner who gets a clear run benefits from others' misfortune.

watchPoints.text: Three Socks On must be monitored for early pace judgment as the only leader in testing conditions over this trip
Hold-up horses Semper Femina and Virtue Chastity both return from significant layoffs and may need the run
Houndswood Willow wears headgear for the first time which could spark improvement or cause distraction
The soft ground may not suit all runners despite their going preferences, with stamina becoming crucial late

races.paceDynamic: Mr Freedom and Cruden will take this forward as the main pace angles, with Selenic also capable of tracking prominently. The small field and soft ground should create a steady, sustainable gallop rather than breakneck early fractions. With five hold-up horses including Aggagio, Premiere Ligne, Maasai Mara, Expressionless and Appier, there's ample ammunition for a closing finish over the extended trip. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can unleash late kicks, as the prominent runners may struggle to sustain their efforts against fresh finishers on testing ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Late Surge Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays controlled and hold-up horses get clear runs
scenarios.body: The prominent duo get outpaced by fresher legs in the final two furlongs, with soft ground aiding stamina types. Multiple closers benefit from the shape and trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Rank Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Mr Freedom and Cruden dictate without pressure and kick clear
scenarios.body: The pace leaders get first run on their rivals and the hold-up brigade leave their moves too late. Prominent racers exploit their positional advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes stop-start with prominent horses eyeing each other
scenarios.body: Mid-race positioning becomes crucial as horses get caught in traffic or forced wide. The most adaptable jockeys find the best routes home.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Shock Winner Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If market leaders underperform and an outsider capitalizes
scenarios.body: Lower-rated horses benefit from a truly-run race that exposes fitness or form concerns in the fancied runners. Class barriers break down over the extended distance.

watchPoints.text: Mr Freedom could get isolated in front if Cruden doesn't commit, leaving him vulnerable to late challengers
Premiere Ligne needs a clear passage from the back as small fields can create traffic problems for hold-up horses
Maasai Mara's recent course win suggests he's found his form and the soft ground plays to his strengths
Aggagio's 41-day absence could blunt his finishing kick despite his excellent soft ground statistics
The pace battle between Mr Freedom, Cruden and Selenic will determine whether closers get their ideal setup

runners_data.name: Overbudget

runners_data.name: Tashi Delek

races.paceDynamic: Double Naughty will dictate proceedings from the front with Q T Pie likely to track her early pace, creating a measured gallop over this stiff 6f at Goodwood. The soft ground will accentuate stamina demands in the closing stages, with the majority of the field (Bundok, Perfect Location, Overbudget, Tashi Delek, Jowalla, Imagine That) positioned to strike from off the pace. With limited early pace pressure, the tempo will be sustainable until the climb to the finish where those with tactical speed from midfield and hold-up positions will have every opportunity to pounce. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and those that can quicken from midfield tracking positions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace remains moderate and the field stays bunched turning for home
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will suit the patient tactics of the hold-up brigade who can unleash their finishing kicks up the testing climb. Horses like Perfect Location and Overbudget with proven soft ground form will benefit from the tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Pair Hold On
scenarios.trigger: If Double Naughty and Q T Pie establish a decisive break and the pace proves genuine enough to blunt closing kicks
scenarios.body: The soft ground stamina test will reward those who get first run, with Double Naughty's recent Goodwood win and Q T Pie's course experience proving crucial. The hold-up horses may find too much to do.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Midfield Swooper Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish from halfway
scenarios.body: A horse like Sierra Sue tracking in midfield can time her challenge perfectly without getting caught in traffic. Her trainer James Horton's 14-day record is poor but her tactical position could prove ideal.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits From Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes messy with interference or a complete collapse in tempo
scenarios.body: Jowalla at a big price could benefit from the weight relief and her hold-up style if the race falls apart completely. Tom Dascombe's filly has shown glimpses of ability in better company.

watchPoints.text: Double Naughty could get an uncontested lead if Q T Pie doesn't go with her early, potentially building an unassailable advantage.
Perfect Location's headgear change to plain could signal improved behavior but watch for any signs of her pulling or racing keenly.
Q T Pie's fitness after 263 days off is a major unknown despite her early career promise.
Overbudget's quick 8-day turnaround suggests connections are confident but watch for any signs of a hard race taking its toll.
The soft ground will test stamina reserves in the final furlong climb, watch for horses dropping away quickly if the pace has been genuine.

races.paceDynamic: Comic Strip will take the field along as the sole confirmed front runner, setting a sustainable tempo without pressure in this small field. With four hold-up horses (Wedonttelllies, Killavia, Saffron Dandy, Carefree Dream) all looking to come from behind, Comic Strip can dictate terms and control the gallop. The soft ground will aid stamina but won't necessarily blunt the turn of foot from the closers over this minimum trip. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners and those with tactical speed who can track the pace, as the hold-up brigade may find themselves with too much ground to make up behind an uncontested leader.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Comic Strip Controls All
scenarios.trigger: If Comic Strip gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The pace-setter exploits the tactical advantage of dictating terms against a field full of hold-up horses who leave themselves too much to do. Comic Strip's prominent style perfectly suits having the race run to suit from the front.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and the closers get their preferred gallop
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses benefit from a dawdling tempo that sets up a cavalry charge, with the best closer prevailing in a tight finish. Wedonttelllies and Killavia can unleash their strongest weapons in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Carefree Dream Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the 7lb claimer Donagh Murphy produces a patient ride and times his challenge perfectly
scenarios.body: The bottom weight benefits from the combination of his claiming allowance, light weight, and tactical ride to spring a surprise. Carefree Dream's recent form at Southwell shows he retains ability despite his low rating.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Saffron Dandy Revival
scenarios.trigger: If Richard Hannon's charge bounces back to his early season form when winning at Salisbury
scenarios.body: The Hannon-trained runner rediscovers the form that saw him win first time out and capitalizes on his yard's solid 14-day strike rate. Saffron Dandy's class tells in the closing stages despite recent disappointing efforts.

watchPoints.text: Comic Strip could exploit the tactical advantage completely if allowed to dictate terms unchallenged from the front against this field of hold-up horses.
Wedonttelllies sports first-time cheekpieces which could sharpen him up significantly for this quick return to Goodwood where he has proven form.
The Crisford stable is winless from 20 recent runners, raising questions about Comic Strip's wellbeing despite his tactical edge in this race.
Carefree Dream carries a 7lb claimer and bottom weight, creating a significant pull in the weights that could offset his moderate official rating.
Monitor the early pace as any dawdling could completely change the complexion and favour the quartet of hold-up horses over the pace-setter.

races.paceDynamic: Desperate Dan is the only confirmed front runner and will control this race from the outset, setting a sustainable pace without pressure from the field loaded with hold-up horses. With Eupator, Arctician, Post Rider and Warning Sign all prominent runners likely to sit just behind, there's enough pace interest to keep things honest through the middle sections. The soft ground at Goodwood's one mile trip typically favours those who can travel and finish, creating a tactical advantage for the hold-up brigade. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can exploit the controlled early pace and unleash late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners sit too close to Desperate Dan early
scenarios.body: The pace becomes genuinely run through the middle sections, perfectly setting up the race for the patient hold-up horses to swoop late. Talis Evolvere and Zoffandia can exploit their tactical advantage with strong late charges.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Pays
scenarios.trigger: If Eupator or Post Rider decide to take the race to Desperate Dan
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and prevents the hold-up horses from getting into contention, favouring those who can press forward and sustain their effort. These prominent runners can capitalise on their forward positions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Kicks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If Desperate Dan gets an easy lead and the field sits too far back
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the leader to dictate completely, building an insurmountable advantage that the late closers cannot reel in despite the soft ground. His recent Goodwood win proves he can handle similar conditions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If all runners decide to wait and the early pace becomes crawling
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where positioning and luck in running matters more than style, potentially favouring any horse who gets a clear run. This chaos scenario could throw up a surprise result from the outsiders.

watchPoints.text: Desperate Dan getting an uncontested lead through the first half-mile could prove decisive as the field may leave it too late
Talis Evolvere's recent disappointing efforts at Goodwood despite his tactical advantage in this race setup
The amateur jockeys' positioning in the early stages as several lack experience in tactical races like this
